name: product::GetProductPaths(executable, key, keyLength, directory, directoryLength, modulePath, modulePathLength, directoryExists) (cdecl, al)
notes: Lane MB (F4e). Writes the constant product key and the executable's product directory (GetModuleFileNameA three levels up, '\\' and the product folder from the executable name: from its sixth character, its last four, or 'Base'); each output only when buffer and length are both given (*length = strlen, strncpy_s(buffer, strlen + 1, text, strlen)); _access for directoryExists. Hooked (product_GetProductPaths); runs in game (coverage run1/run3: FindProductDirectories, SetupUserDataDirectories, Init, the common system). Test ProductInfo_GetProductPaths: 2688 cases (executable names incl. short / long / 'Sims2.exe', module paths of 0..5 levels, every null combination of the outputs, buffer canaries); GetModuleFileNameA and _access faked (IAT / CRT stand-ins); compared al, every buffer byte and length. Mutants (lane MB, build/mb_mutants_b.json): the copy length, the separator strip, the strip count, the Base folder, the existence test without a directory: killed.

name: product::FindNewerProduct(outExecutable, outScore) (cdecl, al)
notes: Lane MB (F4e). Scores each listed product (index, +1000 'Sims2SP', +2000 'Sims2SC' or an expansion after the third), keeps the first best, writes the name and score when asked; newer when the score is above 2016 (never with the fixed list). Hooked; runs in game at Init (coverage run1 / run3, 1.1 s; the latest run's site list lacked it, which is why it showed as never running). Test ProductInfo_FindNewerProduct: 260 cases (scripted lists of SP / SC / EP names, empty entries, null outputs); compared al, out and score. Mutants (lane MB, build/mb_mutants_b.json): the older-expansion boundary, the threshold test: killed; 'score >= bestScore' survived, equivalent: the product list is a constant with distinct scores, and index 0 scores 0, so a tie only ever moves best from 0 to 0.
